candidate_relationships.llm_concern: Missing verified parent type and definition; subclasshood rests only on the child's stated genus.
candidate_relationships.llm_rationale: The child is defined as a train differentiated by passenger conveyance, so the proposed genus-differentia relation is coherent. Parent train has no supplied definition or verified superclass, so its category is not independently established.

candidate_relationships.llm_concern: The 'may be conveyed' clause leaves passenger participation optional and does not further specify process boundaries.
candidate_relationships.llm_rationale: The child is defined as a process of train travel between stations, and process is a verified occurrent with temporal parts and participants. Optional passenger conveyance does not undermine processhood.

candidate_relationships.llm_concern: No concern about category mismatch; bearer of the plan is unspecified but not required for this subclass claim.
candidate_relationships.llm_rationale: The child is defined as an information content entity about an intended journey and explicitly not the journey. That matches information content entity as a generically dependent continuant that is about something.

candidate_relationships.llm_concern: Bearer is restricted to an undefined person class; that differentia is narrower than BFO role but is not a category error.
candidate_relationships.llm_rationale: The child is defined as a role type inhering in a person and realized by conveyed-traveler participation, not as a person. Role is a verified realizable entity, so the role-to-role subclass is compatible.

candidate_relationships.llm_concern: Passenger has no supplied definition, so its differentia cannot be checked against conveyed rail travel.
candidate_relationships.llm_rationale: Verified source places passenger under role, so it is a role type, not a person or bearer. A rail conveyed-traveler role is a plausible specialization, but role ancestry alone does not prove this subclass.

candidate_relationships.llm_concern: Parent textual definition is missing; the IRI is reservation while the label is reservation information.
candidate_relationships.llm_rationale: The child is reservation information about a held rail booking and is explicitly not a material ticket or journey. Parent is verified as an information content entity, which fits that information reading.

candidate_relationships.llm_concern: Physical bearer versus electronic ticket information content remains unresolved; an information-only ticket would not fit this material bearer parent.
candidate_relationships.llm_rationale: As stated, the child is a ticket and a material information bearer authorizing rail travel, matching ticket's verified material-information-bearer superclass. That supports only the physical-bearer reading.

candidate_relationships.llm_concern: Facilities could be confused with an immaterial site; the stated definition commits to material parts, but no tighter facility or aggregate parent is verified.
candidate_relationships.llm_rationale: The child is defined as a material entity of physical railway facilities, and material entity is a verified independent continuant with matter as part. Platforms, structures, and buildings fit that reading.

candidate_relationships.llm_concern: Object aggregate might be a tighter parent, but none is supplied; material entity remains compatible.
candidate_relationships.llm_rationale: The child is defined as a material entity composed of rail vehicles, matching material entity's verified independent-continuant and matter criteria. A train is not a role or information entity.

method: Separate held-out cosine and source-grounded Grok. No numeric hybrid probability until calibrated with independent positives AND negatives.

score_interpretation.cosine: [-1,1] vector directional similarity only, not entailment or subclass confidence
score_interpretation.cosine_reference_percentile_descriptive: Fraction of held-out source/import subclass pairs with cosine <= rail pair. NOT a validity probability; no negative-label control.
score_interpretation.hybrid_confidence_score: Always null until a proper labeled calibration is created; the v1 weighted number is saved only for audit
score_interpretation.llm_plausibility: Uncalibrated heuristic supplied by Grok; must be checked against verified source facts

unresolved_design_decisions: rail ticket physical bearer vs electronic information
